home.captionLine2: born 2004, based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

about.bio1Rest: esse is a Kuala Lumpur–based model and talent working across editorial, campaign and beauty. Comfortable in front of a beauty macro lens or sunk into a full look on a coloured set, she moves between soft, expressive close-ups and character-driven campaign work with the same ease.
about.bio2: Off set, she's usually behind a microphone, a brush, or a camera of her own — a multi-hyphenate approach to the industry that keeps every shoot feeling considered rather than routine.

work.heading: Selected Work
work.intro: Seven series pulled from studio, editorial and campaign sessions — comp-card lookbook, sport-red editorial, street style, quiet portraiture, an Elena Blair editorial, bridal beauty, and product campaigns.

klfw.title: KLFW × L’Oréal, 2026
klfw.text: Runway modelling for L’Oréal at Kuala Lumpur Fashion Week.

more.heading: Also Working On
more.intro: Modelling is one thread — the rest of the practice runs alongside it.

items.title: Podcast — Two Chatters
items.text: People from completely different walks of life still carry their own stories worth telling — that idea sits behind Two Chatters. It actually started alone: talking out loud to an empty room, the way some people think best out loud rather than in silence. Recording it on a phone turned that habit into something worth keeping, and finding a like-minded friend to sit across the mic turned it into a proper, ongoing project — still, at its core, just a fun thing to make together.

items.title: Makeup Enthusiasm
items.text: Self-taught in makeup artistry. First picked up makeup at 15 through cosplay, and everything since has been built through hands-on practice — trial and error, tutorials, and knowledge traded back and forth with other makeup artists along the way. Currently developing Kira Project, an upcoming bespoke makeover concept in the spirit of a fine portrait studio — part styled photography, part full-look transformation, offered as a paid service.

items.title: Talent Scouting
items.text: Handles talent scouting for Elena Blair, sourcing models, makeup artists, producers and stylists for the team. Currently wears several of those hats herself within it — model, makeup artist, stylist, photographer, and social media manager.

items.title: Art Practice
items.text: Studied Fine Art at Dasein Academy, with a working knowledge of art history and formal art systems. Keeps an ongoing personal practice alongside client work, spanning photography, performance and live art.

items.title: Social Media
items.text: Currently building out the personal page of a Rubik's-cube enthusiast from the ground up, shaping the account's content and voice across a run of experimental, fast-cut edits that push past the usual social-media format — visible across both the Instagram page and its TikTok companion.
